description: Lint many Solidity files at once. Use before treating Solidity work as finished, or when you do not know which files changed. Without a pattern it tries contracts/** then src/**. For one known file prefer lint_file; for source not saved yet use lint_solidity.

pattern.description: Optional project-relative glob, e.g. 'contracts/**/*.sol'. Omit to autodetect.

name: lint_project
